verdict.rationale: Zep's performance docs state a retrieval-latency target of "sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs," and the quick start repeats the under-200ms figure. That is a documented target, but it is a marketing-level bound with no measured percentiles, benchmark methodology or independent measurements behind it. Missing for 10: measured p50/p95/p99 numbers, benchmark methodology and conditions, independent or hands-on latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims
